shortDescription: Create, update, or delete an Endpoint

options.name: attributes
options.description: A list of Endpoint role attributes prefixed with a \#hash mark.

options.name: dest
options.description: Path to directory or file named like *.jwt in which to save the enrollment one-time-token JWT. If a directory is specified then it will be created if necessary and the filename will be that of the Endpoint, including whitespace, and must have filename suffix *.jwt.

options.name: network
options.description: The dictionary describing the Network on which to operate from netfoundry_info.network.

options.name: sessionIdentity
options.description: UUID of an identity that must maintain a concurrent web console session in order for this Endpoint to remain active

options.name: wait
options.description: seconds to wait for specified status.
